reasons: Selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but the dataset only has the metric as type sum; the selector would match no series.
rate() is applied, but Datadog docker.net.bytes_sent is a level of cumulative bytes sent, so the candidate changes the quantity to bytes per second (By/s) instead of bytes.

Metric has an interface attribute and the dataset yields one series per interface; avg by container_image_name averages across interfaces, while Datadog's series is per container. Sum by container/image before averaging, or note the grain difference.
Label container_image_name is observed in the dataset and matches by docker_image; the scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
